title: Hafta kunlari, oylar va sanalar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida hafta kunlari va oylarni to‘g‘ri aytib yozasiz, tartib sonlar bilan sanani ayta olasiz, on, in, at ni adashtirmaysiz va tug‘ilgan kuningiz hamda uchta muhim sanani ingliz tilida aytasiz.

scenes.title: Hafta kunlari, oylar va sanalar
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n beshinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda inkor gaplar tuzishni o‘rgandik. Bugun vaqt bilan bog‘liq muhim mavzu: hafta kunlari, oylar va sanalar. Dars oxirida tug‘ilgan kuningizni, uchrashuv kunini va muhim sanalarni ingliz tilida to‘g‘ri aytasiz, on, in va at old qo‘shimchalarini adashtirmaysiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will learn the days, the months and dates. You will say your birthday in English.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun hafta kunlarini, oylarni va sanalarni o‘rganamiz. Tug‘ilgan kuningizni ingliz tilida aytasiz.

scenes.title: Hafta kunlari
scenes.say_native: Haftada yetti kun bor. Monday — dushanba. Tuesday — seshanba. Wednesday — chorshanba. Thursday — payshanba. Friday — juma. Saturday — shanba. Sunday — yakshanba. Eng muhim qoida: inglizchada hafta kunlari doim bosh harf bilan yoziladi, o‘zbekchadan farqli o‘laroq. Saturday va Sunday birgalikda weekend, ya’ni dam olish kunlari. Qolgan beshtasi weekdays.
scenes.say: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba, seshanba, chorshanba, payshanba, juma, shanba, yakshanba. Shanba va yakshanba dam olish kunlari.

scenes.title: Talaffuz va yozilish
scenes.say_native: Ba’zi kunlar yozilishi va aytilishi bo‘yicha farq qiladi. Wednesday — “vensdey” kabi, d harfi aytilmaydi, uch bo‘g‘in emas, ikki bo‘g‘in: WENZ-day. Thursday’da boshida th tovushi, tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘yasiz. Tuesday’da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda. Hamma kunlarda oxirgi qism “day” ni “dey” deb aytamiz, “di” emas. Urg‘u hamma kunlarda birinchi bo‘g‘inga tushadi.
scenes.say: Monday. Tuesday. Wednesday. Thursday. Friday. Saturday. Sunday.
scenes.say_uz: Dushanba. Seshanba. Chorshanba. Payshanba. Juma. Shanba. Yakshanba.

scenes.title: Qaysi kun?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Kunlarni topib ayting. Birinchi: dushanbadan keyin qaysi kun. Ikkinchi: jumadan oldin qaysi kun. Uchinchi: seshanba bilan payshanba o‘rtasida qaysi kun. To‘rtinchi: shanbadan keyin qaysi kun. Javobni to‘liq ayting va talaffuzga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: What day is after Monday? What day is before Friday? What day is between Tuesday and Thursday? What day is after Saturday?
scenes.say_uz: Dushanbadan keyin qaysi kun? Jumadan oldin qaysi kun? Seshanba bilan payshanba o‘rtasida qaysi kun? Shanbadan keyin qaysi kun?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Dushanbadan keyin Tuesday, seshanba. Jumadan oldin Thursday, payshanba. Seshanba bilan payshanba o‘rtasida Wednesday, chorshanba. Shanbadan keyin Sunday, yakshanba. Bu savolning shakli ham foydali: What day is it today? — bugun qaysi kun? Javob: It’s Wednesday.
scenes.say: Tuesday. Thursday. Wednesday. Sunday. What day is it today? It's Wednesday.
scenes.say_uz: Seshanba. Payshanba. Chorshanba. Yakshanba. Bugun qaysi kun? Chorshanba.

scenes.title: Oylar: yanvardan iyungacha
scenes.say_native: Endi oylar. Yilda o‘n ikkita oy bor. January — yanvar. February — fevral. March — mart. April — aprel. May — may. June — iyun. O‘zbekchada oy nomlari kichik harf bilan yoziladi, inglizchada esa hafta kunlari kabi doim bosh harf bilan: January, March. Bu yerda ham “bosh harf” qoidasi bor, buni unutmang. February yozilishi qiyin, undagi birinchi r harfini unutmang.
scenes.say: January, February, March, April, May, June.
scenes.say_uz: Yanvar, fevral, mart, aprel, may, iyun.

scenes.title: Oylar: iyuldan dekabrgacha
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi yarmi: July — iyul. August — avgust. September — sentabr. October — oktabr. November — noyabr. December — dekabr. Urg‘uga e’tibor bering: July’da urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda, “ju-LAI”. September, October, November, December so‘zlarida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: sep-TEM-ber, oc-TO-ber. Bu o‘zbekchadagi talaffuzdan farq qiladi, chunki biz ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u beramiz.
scenes.say: July, August, September, October, November, December.
scenes.say_uz: Iyul, avgust, sentabr, oktabr, noyabr, dekabr.

scenes.title: Qaysi oy?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Oylarni toping. Birinchi: martdan keyin qaysi oy. Ikkinchi: iyuldan oldin qaysi oy. Uchinchi: yilning birinchi oyi. To‘rtinchi: yilning oxirgi oyi. Oy nomlarini bosh harf bilan yozishni ham xayolingizda saqlang.
scenes.say: What month is after March? What month is before July? What is the first month? What is the last month?
scenes.say_uz: Martdan keyin qaysi oy? Iyuldan oldin qaysi oy? Birinchi oy qaysi? Oxirgi oy qaysi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Martdan keyin April, aprel. Iyuldan oldin June, iyun. Birinchi oy January, yanvar. Oxirgi oy December, dekabr. Agar ularni sekin, ammo to‘g‘ri talaffuz bilan aytgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi. Tezlik keyin keladi.
scenes.say: April. June. January. December.
scenes.say_uz: Aprel. Iyun. Yanvar. Dekabr.

scenes.title: Qisqartmalar
board: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun
Jan Feb Mar Apr Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec
scenes.say_native: Kalendar va jadvallarda kunlar va oylar qisqartirilgan holda yoziladi. Kunlar uchun uch harf: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun. Oylar uchun ham uch harf: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec. May esa o‘zi qisqa, shuning uchun qisqartirilmaydi. Mon 5 May deb o‘qiladi: Monday, the fifth of May. Qisqartmalarni ham bosh harf bilan yozing.
scenes.say: Mon, Tue, Wed. Jan, Feb, Mar. Mon fifth May means Monday, the fifth of May.
scenes.say_uz: Dush, sesh, chor. Yan, fev, mar. Mon 5 May bu Monday, the fifth of May.

scenes.title: On, in, at: asosiy qoida
board: in + oy / yil: in March, in 2026
scenes.say_native: Endi old qo‘shimchalar. Hafta kuni bilan on: on Monday, on Friday. Oy va yil bilan in: in March, in 2026. Aniq soat bilan at: at five o’clock. Bu uch so‘z uchta qoidani bildiradi. O‘zbek tilida bu vazifani -da qo‘shimchasi va “kuni” so‘zi bajaradi: dushanba kuni, martda. Inglizchada esa qaysi old qo‘shimcha kerakligini yodlash kerak: kun uchun on, oy uchun in.
scenes.say: I have English on Monday. My birthday is in March. The lesson is at five o'clock. We travel in 2026.
scenes.say_uz: Menda ingliz tili dushanba kuni. Mening tug‘ilgan kunim martda. Dars soat beshda. Biz 2026 yilda sayohat qilamiz.

scenes.title: Sana va kun qismlari
scenes.say_native: Aniq sana bilan ham on ishlatiladi: on the fifth of May. Kun qismlari bilan in: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening. Faqat at night, ya’ni tunda. Lekin kun nomi bilan birga kelsa, yana on: on Monday morning, on Friday evening. Kunlarni ko‘plikda ishlatsak, “har shanba” ma’nosi chiqadi: I work on Saturdays. Dam olish kunlari uchun britaniyaliklar at the weekend deyishadi, amerikaliklar esa on the weekend.
scenes.say: I work on Saturdays. See you on Monday morning. I study in the evening. We sleep at night.
scenes.say_uz: Men shanba kunlari ishlayman. Dushanba ertalab ko‘rishamiz. Men kechqurun o‘qiyman. Biz tunda uxlaymiz.

scenes.title: On, in, at xatolari
scenes.say_native: Uchta mashhur xato. Birinchisi: hafta kuni bilan in yoki at ishlatish, “in Monday”. To‘g‘risi on Monday. Ikkinchisi: oy bilan on yoki at, “on March”. To‘g‘risi in March. Uchinchisi: aniq sana bilan in, “in the 5th of May”. Bu ham on bo‘lishi kerak: on the fifth of May. Qisqa qoida: kun va sana uchun on, oy, yil va kun qismlari uchun in.
scenes.say: Not: in Monday. Say: on Monday. Not: on March. Say: in March. Not: in the fifth of May. Say: on the fifth of May.
scenes.say_uz: In Monday emas. On Monday deng. On March emas. In March deng. In the fifth of May emas. On the fifth of May deng.

scenes.title: On yoki in?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir ibora uchun to‘g‘ri old qo‘shimchani ayting: on, in yoki at. Birinchi: seshanba. Ikkinchi: iyul. Uchinchi: ikki ming o‘ttizinchi yil. To‘rtinchi: o‘n ikkinchi aprel. Beshinchi: kechqurun. Har birini to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: On or in? Tuesday. July. Twenty thirty. The twelfth of April. The evening.
scenes.say_uz: On yoki in? Seshanba. Iyul. Ikki ming o‘ttiz. O‘n ikkinchi aprel. Kechqurun.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Seshanba — on Tuesday. Iyul — in July. 2030 — in 2030. O‘n ikkinchi aprel — on the twelfth of April. Kechqurun — in the evening. Besh javobdan to‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, qoidani yaxshi tushunibsiz. Eslab qoling: on aniq kun, in uzoqroq vaqt oralig‘i.
scenes.say: On Tuesday. In July. In twenty thirty. On the twelfth of April. In the evening.
scenes.say_uz: Seshanba kuni. Iyulda. Ikki ming o‘ttizda. O‘n ikkinchi aprelda. Kechqurun.

scenes.title: Kecha, bugun, ertaga

examples.t: I have an exam next Friday.

scenes.say_native: Kun nomlari bilan ishlatiladigan foydali so‘zlar: yesterday — kecha, today — bugun, tomorrow — ertaga. Next Monday — keyingi dushanba, last Friday — o‘tgan juma. Every Sunday — har yakshanba. Muhim narsa: bu so‘zlar oldidan on, in yoki at kerak emas. “On tomorrow” yoki “on next Friday” deb aytmaysiz, to‘g‘risi tomorrow va next Friday. “The day after tomorrow” — indinga.
scenes.say: Yesterday, today, tomorrow. See you tomorrow! I have an exam next Friday. The day after tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Kecha, bugun, ertaga. Ertaga ko‘rishamiz! Keyingi juma kuni imtihonim bor. Indinga.

scenes.title: Bugun chorshanba
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bugun chorshanba deb tasavvur qiling. Birinchi: ertaga qaysi kun. Ikkinchi: kecha qaysi kun edi. Uchinchi: indin qaysi kun. Javoblarni to‘liq jumla bilan ayting, masalan: Tomorrow is…
scenes.say: Today is Wednesday. What day is tomorrow? What day was yesterday? What day is the day after tomorrow?
scenes.say_uz: Bugun chorshanba. Ertaga qaysi kun? Kecha qaysi kun edi? Indin qaysi kun?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: The day after tomorrow is Friday.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ertaga payshanba: tomorrow is Thursday. Kecha seshanba edi: yesterday was Tuesday. Indin juma: the day after tomorrow is Friday. Yesterday bilan “was” ishlatilganini payqadingiz, bu o‘tgan zamonni bildiradi. Uni keyingi darslarda alohida o‘rganamiz, hozir tayyor iboralar sifatida yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Tomorrow is Thursday. Yesterday was Tuesday. The day after tomorrow is Friday.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga payshanba. Kecha seshanba edi. Indin juma.

scenes.title: Tartib sonlar: 1 dan 12 gacha

examples.t: Her birthday is on the third of June.

scenes.say_native: Sanani aytish uchun tartib sonlar kerak, ya’ni birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi. Inglizchada first, second, third. Birinchi uchtasi o‘zgacha, ularni yodlang. Keyin to‘rtdan boshlab sonning oxiriga th qo‘shiladi: fourth, sixth, seventh, tenth. Uchta so‘z imlosi o‘zgaradi: fifth, ve o‘rniga f. Eighth, bitta t ketadi. Ninth, e tushib qoladi. Twelfth, ve o‘rniga f.
scenes.say: First, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh, twelfth.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi, to‘rtinchi, beshinchi, oltinchi, yettinchi, sakkizinchi, to‘qqizinchi, o‘ninchi, o‘n birinchi, o‘n ikkinchi.

scenes.title: Tartib sonlar: 13 dan 31 gacha
scenes.say_native: O‘n uchdan o‘n to‘qqizgacha th qo‘shamiz: thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth. Yigirma uchun twentieth, ya’ni y harfi ie ga aylanadi, o‘ttiz uchun thirtieth. Murakkab sonlarda faqat oxirgi qism tartib songa aylanadi: twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third, twenty-fourth. Sana yozilganda raqamdan keyin st, nd, rd yoki th keladi: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 21st, 22nd, 23rd, 31st.
scenes.say: Thirteenth, fifteenth, twentieth, twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third, thirtieth, thirty-first.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uchinchi, o‘n beshinchi, yigirmanchi, yigirma birinchi, yigirma ikkinchi, yigirma uchinchi, o‘ttizinchi, o‘ttiz birinchi.

scenes.title: Tartib sonlardagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: oddiy qoida bo‘yicha th qo‘shib, “fiveth” yoki “twelveth” deyish. To‘g‘risi fifth va twelfth. Ikkinchisi: sanada oddiy son ishlatish, “the three of May”. Inglizchada tartib son kerak: the third of May. Uchinchisi: murakkab sonda hamma qismni o‘zgartirish, “twenty-oneth”. Faqat oxirgisi: twenty-first. O‘zbekchada “3-may” deymiz, bu yerda ham aslida tartib son bor, lekin yozuvda yashirin turadi.
scenes.say: Not: fiveth. Say: fifth. Not: the three of May. Say: the third of May. Not: twenty-oneth. Say: twenty-first.
scenes.say_uz: Fiveth emas. Fifth deng. The three of May emas. The third of May deng. Twenty-oneth emas. Twenty-first deng.

scenes.title: Raqamni so‘z bilan ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Raqamli tartib sonlarni so‘z bilan ayting. Birinchi: 3rd. Ikkinchi: 5th. Uchinchi: 12th. To‘rtinchi: 22nd. Beshinchi: 31st. Fifth va twelfth so‘zlarida oxirgi th tovushiga e’tibor bering, tilingiz tishlaringiz orasida bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Say these in words. Three, five, twelve, twenty-two, thirty-one, as ordinals.
scenes.say_uz: Buni so‘z bilan ayting. Uch, besh, o‘n ikki, yigirma ikki, o‘ttiz bir, tartib son sifatida.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. 3rd — third. 5th — fifth. 12th — twelfth. 22nd — twenty-second. 31st — thirty-first. Fifth so‘zida oxirida ikkita undosh yonma-yon: f va th, ularni ketma-ket aytish qiyin, lekin mashq qilsangiz bo‘ladi. Twelfth’da ham shunday. Bu so‘zlarni sekin boshlab, keyin tezlating.
scenes.say: Third. Fifth. Twelfth. Twenty-second. Thirty-first.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi. Beshinchi. O‘n ikkinchi. Yigirma ikkinchi. O‘ttiz birinchi.

scenes.title: Sanani aytish: britancha
board: 5th May / 5 May → the fifth of May

examples.t: His birthday is on the 21st of June.
examples.uz: Uning tug‘ilgan kuni yigirma birinchi iyunda.

scenes.say_native: Britaniya ingliz tilida sana tartibi: kun, keyin oy. Yozilishi 5th May yoki 5 May, aytilishi the fifth of May. Ya’ni the va of ishlatiladi. Bu o‘zbek tiliga o‘xshaydi: avval kun, keyin oy, “besh may”. Yilni oxirida qo‘shamiz: the fifth of May, twenty twenty-six. Sanani so‘rash uchun: What’s the date today? Javob: It’s the fifth of May.
scenes.say: What's the date today? It's the fifth of May. His birthday is on the twenty-first of June.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun sana nechi? Besh may. Uning tug‘ilgan kuni yigirma birinchi iyunda.

scenes.title: Amerikacha sana va yillar
scenes.say_native: Amerikaliklar oyni birinchi aytishadi: May fifth, May 5. Shuning uchun 05/06/2026 ko‘rinishidagi sana Britaniyada 5 iyun, AQShda esa 6 may. Bu chalkashlikka e’tibor bering! Yillar odatda ikki qismga bo‘lib aytiladi: 1999 — nineteen ninety-nine, 2026 — twenty twenty-six. Faqat 2000 — two thousand, 2005 — two thousand and five. Yilda hech qachon “the” ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Nineteen ninety-nine. Twenty twenty-six. Two thousand. May fifth is the American way.
scenes.say_uz: Bir ming to‘qqiz yuz to‘qson to‘qqiz. Ikki ming yigirma olti. Ikki ming. May fifth amerikacha usul.

scenes.title: Sanalarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Sanalarni britancha usulda to‘liq ayting. Birinchi: 3 March. Ikkinchi: 21 June. Uchinchi: 12 October. To‘rtinchi: 2030 yilni ayting. Namuna: “the third of March”. Tartib sonlarni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: Say the dates. The third of March. Now you: twenty-one June, twelve October, and the year twenty thirty.
scenes.say_uz: Sanalarni ayting. Uchinchi mart. Endi siz: yigirma bir iyun, o‘n ikki oktabr va ikki ming o‘ttiz yil.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. 3 March — the third of March. 21 June — the twenty-first of June. 12 October — the twelfth of October. 2030 — twenty thirty. Birinchi so‘zni ham unutmang: the. Sanani gap ichida ishlatganda on qo‘shing: on the twelfth of October. Yilda esa in kerak: in twenty thirty.
scenes.say: The third of March. The twenty-first of June. The twelfth of October. Twenty thirty.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi mart. Yigirma birinchi iyun. O‘n ikkinchi oktabr. Ikki ming o‘ttiz.

scenes.title: Tug‘ilgan kun

examples.t: My birthday is on the 12th of March.
examples.uz: Mening tug‘ilgan kunim o‘n ikkinchi martda.

scenes.say_native: Tug‘ilgan kunni so‘rash: When’s your birthday? Javob: My birthday is on the twelfth of March. Qisqa javob: It’s on the twelfth of March yoki shunchaki the twelfth of March. Faqat oyni aytsangiz in kerak: My birthday is in March. Tabriklash uchun: Happy birthday! Javob: Thank you! Tug‘ilgan yilni aytmoqchi bo‘lsangiz: I was born in 1995. Yil bilan in, kun bilan on.
scenes.say: When's your birthday? My birthday is on the twelfth of March. I was born in nineteen ninety-five. Happy birthday!
scenes.say_uz: Tug‘ilgan kuningiz qachon? Tug‘ilgan kunim o‘n ikkinchi martda. Men 1995 yilda tug‘ilganman. Tug‘ilgan kuningiz muborak!

scenes.title: Sana va kunni so‘rash
board: What day is it today? — It's Friday.
What's the date today? — It's the 5th of May.
When is the exam? — On the 5th of June.
scenes.say_native: Uchta asosiy savol. Bugun hafta kunini so‘rash: What day is it today? Javob: It’s Friday. Sanani so‘rash: What’s the date today? Javob: It’s the fifth of May. Voqea vaqtini so‘rash: When is the exam? Javob: On the fifth of June. O‘zbekchada “bugun nechanchi?” deymiz, inglizchada esa kunni va sanani alohida so‘raymiz, bu ikki savolni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: What day is it today? It's Friday. What's the date today? It's the fifth of May. When is the exam?
scenes.say_uz: Bugun qaysi kun? Juma. Bugun sana nechi? Besh may. Imtihon qachon?

scenes.title: Uchrashuv va band bo‘lish
board: I have an appointment on Tuesday at 10.
I'm busy on Monday. / I'm free on Sunday.
scenes.say_native: Uchrashuv va qabul haqida gapirish uchun: I have an appointment on Tuesday at ten. Appointment — oldindan kelishilgan qabul, shifokor yoki ofisdagi uchrashuv. Vaqt so‘rash: Are you free on Friday? — juma kuni bo‘shmisiz? Javob: I’m free yoki I’m busy, ya’ni bandman. Kun va soat birga kelsa, avval kun, keyin soat: on Tuesday at ten.
scenes.say: I have an appointment on Tuesday at ten. Are you free on Friday? I'm busy on Monday. I'm free on Sunday.
scenes.say_uz: Seshanba kuni soat o‘nda qabulim bor. Juma kuni bo‘shmisiz? Dushanba kuni bandman. Yakshanba kuni bo‘shman.

scenes.title: Dialog: shifokorga yozilish
board: A: I'd like an appointment, please.
B: How about Wednesday the 13th at ten?
B: Your name? A: Aziz Karimov.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Bemor stomatologning qabulxonasiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, vaqt belgilaydi. Qaysi kun, qaysi sana va soat nechada kelishilganini diqqat bilan tinglang. Shuningdek, u qaysi kuni kelolmasligini ham eshiting.
scenes.say: Good morning. I'd like an appointment, please. Is Tuesday the twelfth OK? No, sorry. I'm busy on Tuesday. How about Wednesday the thirteenth of March at ten o'clock? Yes, that's fine. Your name, please? Aziz Karimov.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Qabulga yozilmoqchiman. Seshanba, o‘n ikkinchi sana to‘g‘rimi? Yo‘q, kechirasiz. Seshanba kuni bandman. Chorshanba, o‘n uchinchi mart, soat o‘nda-chi? Ha, bo‘ladi. Ismingiz? Aziz Karimov.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What is the new day and date?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: Aziz qaysi kuni band? Ikkinchi: yangi kun va sana qaysi? Uchinchi: soat nechada? To‘rtinchi: uning ismi nima? Sanani tartib son bilan ayting va old qo‘shimchaga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Which day is he busy? What is the new day and date? What time is the appointment? What is his name?
scenes.say_uz: U qaysi kuni band? Yangi kun va sana qaysi? Qabul soat nechada? Uning ismi nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. U seshanba kuni band: he’s busy on Tuesday. Yangi kun chorshanba, o‘n uchinchi mart: Wednesday the thirteenth of March. Soat o‘nda: at ten o’clock. Ismi Aziz Karimov. Dialogdagi on Tuesday, on Wednesday va at ten o’clock iboralarini eslab qoling, ular bugungi qoidaning amaldagi namunasi.
scenes.say: He is busy on Tuesday. Wednesday the thirteenth of March. At ten o'clock. Aziz Karimov.
scenes.say_uz: U seshanba kuni band. Chorshanba, o‘n uchinchi mart. Soat o‘nda. Aziz Karimov.

scenes.title: Dialog: tug‘ilgan kun taklifi
board: B: It's on the 21st of June. Can you come to my party?
A: Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday.
B: OK, let's meet on Sunday at six.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st tug‘ilgan kun haqida gaplashmoqda. Eshiting: Noraning tug‘ilgan kuni qachon, ziyofat qaysi kun, do‘sti nega kela olmaydi va ular qachon uchrashishga kelishadi.
scenes.say: When's your birthday, Nora? It's on the twenty-first of June. I'm having a party on Saturday. Can you come? Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday. Are you free on Sunday? Yes, I am. OK, let's meet on Sunday at six. Great. See you then!
scenes.say_uz: Nora, tug‘ilgan kuningiz qachon? Yigirma birinchi iyunda. Shanba kuni ziyofat qilaman. Kela olasizmi? Kechirasiz, shanba kuni bandman. Yakshanba kuni bo‘shmisiz? Ha. Mayli, yakshanba kuni soat oltida uchrashaylik. Zo‘r. Ko‘rishguncha!

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Noraning tug‘ilgan kuni qachon? Ikkinchi: ziyofat qachon? Uchinchi: do‘sti nega kela olmaydi? To‘rtinchi: ular qachon uchrashadi? Sanani, kunni va soatni to‘g‘ri old qo‘shimcha bilan ayting.
scenes.say: When is Nora's birthday? When is the party? Why can't he come? When do they meet?
scenes.say_uz: Noraning tug‘ilgan kuni qachon? Ziyofat qachon? U nega kela olmaydi? Ular qachon uchrashadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Noraning tug‘ilgan kuni yigirma birinchi iyunda: on the twenty-first of June. Ziyofat shanba kuni: on Saturday. U kela olmaydi, chunki shanba kuni band. Ular yakshanba kuni soat oltida uchrashadi: on Sunday at six. Ko‘rdingizmi, har bir javobda on yoki at bor. Eng muhimi, siz bu ikki so‘zni endi adashtirmayapsiz.
scenes.say: On the twenty-first of June. On Saturday. He is busy on Saturday. On Sunday at six.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirma birinchi iyunda. Shanba kuni. U shanba kuni band. Yakshanba kuni soat oltida.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: sanalar
board: the fifth of May → 'the fifth a May' (of = /əv/)
scenes.say_native: Tez nutqda of so‘zi deyarli eshitilmaydi, “a” yoki “uv” kabi kuchsiz aytiladi: the fifth of May, “the fifth a May”. Shuning uchun inglizlar gapirganda sanani tushunish qiyin tuyulishi mumkin. O‘zingiz aytganda ham of ni yengil, tez ayting. Yana bir narsa: fifth va twelfth kabi so‘zlarda th tovushi oxirida aniq eshitilishi kerak, aks holda “fif” yoki “twelf” bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: The fifth of May. The twelfth of October. My birthday is on the twenty-first of June.
scenes.say_uz: Besh may. O‘n ikkinchi oktabr. Mening tug‘ilgan kunim yigirma birinchi iyunda.

scenes.title: Bog‘lab takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Of so‘zini yengil va tez ayting. The fifth of May. The twelfth of October. Va on Thursday at ten. Har birini avval sekin, keyin tabiiy tezlikda ayting. Th tovushini oxirigacha eshitiladigan qiling.
scenes.say: The fifth of May. The twelfth of October. On Thursday at ten.
scenes.say_uz: Besh may. O‘n ikkinchi oktabr. Payshanba kuni soat o‘nda.

scenes.title: Namuna talaffuz
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Endi o‘zingizni tekshiring. Birinchisi: the fifth of May, bunda of kuchsiz. Ikkinchisi: the twelfth of October, twelfth oxirida th aniq. Uchinchisi: on Thursday at ten, bunda Thursday’ning birinchi bo‘g‘ini kuchli. Agar siz shu uchtasini yoddan, jumlaning ohangini buzmasdan ayta olsangiz, o‘zingizni tabiiy gapirayotgan deb hisoblashingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: The fifth of May. The twelfth of October. On Thursday at ten.
scenes.say_uz: Besh may. O‘n ikkinchi oktabr. Payshanba kuni soat o‘nda.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda ayting
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. O‘zingizning tug‘ilgan kuningizni ayting: My birthday is on… Keyin shu yildagi uchta muhim sanani ayting, masalan imtihon, bayram yoki sayohat. Har biriga old qo‘shimcha qo‘shing: on, in yoki at. Kamida to‘rtta jumla ayting.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Tell me your birthday. Then tell me three important dates this year. Use on, in and at.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Tug‘ilgan kuningizni ayting. Keyin shu yildagi uchta muhim sanani ayting. On, in va at dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: My birthday is on the 12th of March.
The exam is on the 5th of June.
We travel in July. The party is at seven.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. My birthday is on the twelfth of March. My English exam is on the fifth of June. We travel to Samarkand in July. The party is on Saturday at seven. Sizning sanalaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Muhimi: sana uchun the va of, tartib son, kun va sana bilan on, oy bilan in, soat bilan at.
scenes.say: My birthday is on the twelfth of March. My exam is on the fifth of June. We travel in July. The party is on Saturday at seven.
scenes.say_uz: Tug‘ilgan kunim o‘n ikkinchi martda. Imtihonim besh iyunda. Biz iyulda sayohat qilamiz. Ziyofat shanba kuni soat yettida.

scenes.title: Darsni yakunlaymiz
board: on Monday • in March • at five
ordinals: first, second, third, fifth, twelfth
the fifth of May • twenty twenty-six
scenes.say_native: Takrorlaymiz. Hafta kunlari va oy nomlari bosh harf bilan yoziladi. Kun va sana bilan on, oy va yil bilan in, soat bilan at. Tartib sonlar: first, second, third, fifth, twelfth, twenty-first. Britancha sana: the fifth of May, amerikachada May fifth. Yillar: twenty twenty-six. Tug‘ilgan kun: My birthday is on the twelfth of March. Uchrashuv: Are you free on Friday? Juda yaxshi ishladingiz!
scenes.say: Days and months have capital letters. On Monday, in March, at five. First, second, third. The fifth of May.
scenes.say_uz: Kunlar va oylar bosh harf bilan yoziladi. Dushanba kuni, martda, soat beshda. Birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi. Besh may.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Record 6 sentences with on / in / at
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Telefoningizga ovoz yozing: tug‘ilgan kuningizni ayting, keyin shu yildagi uchta muhim sanani ayting, jami kamida oltita jumla bo‘lsin. Tekshiring: tartib sonlar to‘g‘ri, hafta kuni bilan on, oy bilan in, soat bilan at ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda ob-havo va fasllarni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Say your birthday and three important dates this year. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Tug‘ilgan kuningizni va shu yildagi uchta muhim sanani ayting. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Telefoningizga ovoz yozing: tug‘ilgan kuningizni va shu yildagi uchta muhim sanani ayting (kamida oltita jumla). Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: tartib sonlar to‘g‘ri aytilgan, hafta kuni bilan on, oy bilan in, soat bilan at ishlatilgan.

quiz.why_uz: Hafta kunlari inglizchada bosh harf bilan yoziladi.
Five tartib sonda fifth bo‘ladi (ve o‘rniga f).
Murakkab sonda oxirgi qism tartib songa o‘tadi: twenty-second.
Sana uchun tartib son va on: on the third of May.
Yillar odatda ikkiga bo‘lib aytiladi: twenty twenty-six.
Britaniyada avval kun, keyin oy: 5 iyun.

quiz.q: A friend asks 'Are you free on Sunday?' You are not available. You say:
quiz.why_uz: Band bo‘lsangiz: I'm busy on Sunday.
